chart.name: Sequential scans
chart.programText:
A = data('pg_scan.seq', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'), rollup='rate').publish(label='A')
B = data('pg_scan.seq_tup_read', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'), rollup='rate').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (B/A).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Index: buffer hits and block reads
chart.programText:
A = data('pg_blks.idx_hit', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'), rollup='rate').publish(label='A')
B = data('pg_blks.idx_read', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'), rollup='rate').publish(label='B')

chart.name: Index scans
chart.programText:
A = data('pg_scan.idx', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'), rollup='rate').publish(label='A')
B = data('pg_scan.idx_tup_fetch', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'), rollup='rate').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (B/A).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Commits and rollbacks
chart.programText:
A = data('pg_xact.commit', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'), rollup='rate').mean(over='1m').publish(label='A')
B = data('pg_xact.rollback', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'), rollup='rate').mean(over='1m').publish(label='B')

chart.name: Rows affected/sec
chart.programText:
A = data('pg_n_tup_c.ins', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'), rollup='rate').publish(label='A')
B = data('pg_n_tup_c.upd', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'), rollup='rate').publish(label='B')
C = data('pg_n_tup_c.del', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'), rollup='rate').publish(label='C')

chart.name: Database size
chart.programText:
A = data('pg_db_size', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql')).mean().publish(label='A')
B = (A).timeshift('1h').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A).timeshift('1d').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = ((A-B)/B*100).publish(label='D')
E = ((A-C)/C*100).publish(label='E')

chart.name: # Rows 7d change %
chart.programText:
A = data('pg_n_tup_g.live', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql')).mean(over='1h').publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).timeshift('1w').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = ((A-B)/B*100).publish(label='C')

chart.name: Table: buffer hits and block reads

B = data('pg_blks.heap_read', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'), rollup='rate').publish(label='B')

chart.name: Transactions/sec 7d change %
chart.programText:

B = data('pg_xact.rollback', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'),rollup='rate').sum().mean(over='1h').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A).timeshift('1w').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (B).timeshift('1w').publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = ((A-C)/C*100).publish(label='E')
F = ((B-D)/D*100).publish(label='F')

chart.name: Blocks read/sec 7d change %

B = data('pg_blks.idx_read', filter=filter('plugin', 'postgresql'),rollup='rate').sum().mean(over='1h').publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = (A).timeshift('1w').publish(label='C', enable=False)
D = (B).timeshift('1w').publish(label='D', enable=False)
E = ((A-C)/C*100).publish(label='E')
F = ((B-D)/D*100).publish(label='F')

chart.name: Top hosts by scans/sec
chart.programText:

C = (A+B).top(count=5).publish(label='C')
